items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Well, on bass, Doug Richards. ... Doug Richards, he took Jimmy Stiles' place. ... Doug's been with me now two or a little better. A good bass player.

ctx.x: Pete Morgan. And who are the other members of your group now?
Well, on bass, Doug Richards. Piano is Joe Fatali. Clarinet is Sonny Rossi. (Inaudible).
Right. And, what do you, I mean, what could you tell us about the other members of hte group?
